headline: President Clinton created an advisory committee to study what public service duties TV stations should have as they switch to digital broadcasting.
what_it_does: This order set up an advisory committee to look at the public interest obligations of TV broadcasters moving to digital television. The committee's job was to study the issue and give advice. Based on the title alone, the order itself does not appear to set new rules for broadcasters.

who_it_affects.how: Their public service duties in the digital era became the subject of the committee's study and advice.
The committee's advice could shape what kinds of public service programming and services digital TV stations provide.
